channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Graffiti towers agreement clears a path for cleanup
item.description: Graffiti tower reaches an agreement, now what?

item.title: Trump says California is full of fraud. Bonta says the claims are 'reckless'
item.description: The California attorney general said Trump's claims are "wrongly and dangerously alleging the [state] government is involved in fraud" and said state authorities have worked arduously over the years to combat fraud, recovering nearly $2.7 billion through criminal and civil prosecutions since 2016.

item.title: He helped take over a dead man's Sherman Oaks home. Now he'll spend more than 16 years in prison
item.description: Matthew Jason Kroth, 52, is the second person to be sentenced as part of a sprawling criminal scheme that targeted the homes of elderly and vulnerable victims.

item.title: Nancy Guthrie's garage door closed, and the 14-hour mystery over her abduction began
item.description: Inside the 14 hours between when Nancy Guthrie was last seen and family members discovered she was missing.

item.title: L.A. County 'imposter' demanded the Guthries pay bitcoin ransom for mother's return, authorities allege
item.description: Derrick Callella, of Hawthorne, was arrested Thursday after federal authorities say he sent "imposter" ransom messages to the family of Savannah Guthrie. The "Today" co-host's mother, Nancy, is still missing in what officials believe was an abduction.

item.title: Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford earns first NFL MVP honor, makes big announcement
item.description: Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford added another stellar achievement to his prolific career, earning his first NFL MVP honor for his standout 2025 season.

item.title: 3 dead, several injured after car crashes into 99 Ranch Market in Westwood
item.description: Three people were killed and several others were injured after a car crashed into the 99 Ranch Market in Westwood on Thursday.

item.title: Tech entrepreneur enters L.A. mayor's race, becoming the latest to take on Karen Bass
item.description: Adam Miller said Los Angeles is on a downward trajectory and is beset with problems. He said it needs someone with strong leadership skills at City Hall.

item.title: Austin Beutner drops out of L.A. mayor's race, citing daughter's death
item.description: Beutner made his announcement a month after his daughter, 22-year-old Emily Beutner, died of undetermined causes.

item.title: L.A. mayor’s race is in major flux, days before deadline
item.description: It's unusual for so many major candidates to be on the fence about a mayoral bid so close to the filing deadline, Pomona College politics professor Sara Sadhwani said.
